title: An integer multiplicity current commutes with ∫_0^1 ds on a continuous, uniformly supported family of test forms
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, X ∈ D_m(ℝ^P) integer multiplicity, K ⊆ ℝ^P compact, φ : ℝ → D^m(ℝ^P) such that (s, x) ↦ φ(s)(x) is continuous on ℝ × ℝ^P and tsupport φ(s) ⊆ K for every s ∈ [0, 1], and ψ ∈ D^m(ℝ^P) with ψ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 φ(s)(x)(v) ds for all x ∈ ℝ^P and v ∈ (ℝ^P)^m. Then ∫_0^1 X(φ(s)) ds = X(ψ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m) (K : Set (Eucl P)) (φ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsCompact K → Continuous (fun p : ℝ × Eucl P => (φ p.1 : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) p.2) → (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, tsupport (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) ⊆ K) → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (v : Fin m → Eucl P), (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x v = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x v) → ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (φ s) = X ψ
